newsitem.title: UK: LME lead hits fresh 18-month low, most others soft.
newsitem.headline: LME lead hits fresh 18-month low, most others soft.

text.p: LEAD - Slides to finish PM kerb just off 18-month low. Further losses expected with support pegged at $610/15, then $600.
COPPER - Ends barely changed, tries to establish new range above $2,345. Cash/threes slightly narrower at $65/$75 backwardation.
ALUMINIUM - Bucks trend, slightly higher. ALLOY - Steady.
NICKEL - Weak, below $7,300. TIN - Softer. ZINC - Barely easier.
